talkingPoints.text: smooth with a soft blur effect

howToUse.text: Use the slim, tapered applicator to apply evenly along the lips. Can be lightly blended with a fingertip for a natural blur effect. Can be used as a soft blur blush.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

texture.text: Smooth matte lip tint, lightweight, soft blur.

benefits.text: Nu Blur Tint gives lips a smooth matte, soft and moist effect without a feeling of dryness. Silk Air-Fit Pigments technology helps the color go on thin and even, without clumping, and helps minimize visible lip lines. The formula can be layered to adjust the color intensity as desired.

positioning.text: Smooth matte lip tint in a warm nude beige for a soft, natural and clean blurred-lip effect.

sellingPoints.text: Soft blur effect; Silk Air-Fit Pigments technology helps color go on thin and even; can be layered to adjust intensity.

finish.text: Smooth matte / soft blur / natural nude.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it completely covers dark lips. “Without a feeling of dryness” should not be interpreted as treating dry lips.
